f10iea. 2026-10-06: k_bank_how, bank_kept, src_issuer, src_gives. 2026-10-06: the bank statement's figures on its card and on the business card. 2026-10-06: pw_show / pw_hide - the eye on the PDF password. 2026-10-06: back_to - the Back button on each step. 2026-10-06: from_filed / from_filed_done / from_filed_none. 2026-10-06: why_huf. 2026-10-06: the Karta's fields for an HUF. 2026-10-06: the More deductions panel on Check. 2026-10-07: co-owned houses, winnings and virtual digital assets, agricultural income, 44AE vehicles, the 80EE / 80EEA check, and the address and contact fields. 2026-10-07: what the readers found: a VDA sold, the person's address (AIS), the employer's address (Form 16). 2026-10-07: capital gains in full: each sale, exemptions, the indexation choice, losses brought forward, gifts, pre-construction interest, the statements. 2026-10-07: ITR-3 from My return: the own-profit-and-loss kinds and fields, why_biz_books, and the CA messages (tax audit s.44AB, a business loss). 2026-10-07: wave 3: residential status, foreign income and assets, clubbing, salary arrears (s.89), the updated return (ITR-U). 2026-10-08: words for the app's own warning before a delete / remove (never silently). 2026-10-08: wave 4: a second Form 16 from the same employer, two employers, the 44AB payments test and 44AD(4), GST per GSTIN, losses from last year's ITR-3, exemption time limits and several exemptions on one sale, the ITR-U of an earlier year (special rates, surcharge, 234C).
